subject.title: [Bug] Feishu: message(action=send) renders card JSON as plain text instead of interactive card (regression)

question: Should a new fix for plain Feishu card JSON in `message(action=send)` require live Feishu proof before adoption, or is source plus focused regression coverage enough for this compatibility repair?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but multiple direct fix PRs closed unmerged after proof/review gating and the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr/needs-maintainer-review, so automation should pause for the Feishu proof bar or adoption path.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a candidate branch or maintainer run shows the supplied card JSON rendering as an interactive card in a real Feishu chat.

options.title: Accept source and test proof
options.body: Sponsor a narrow Feishu parser fix with focused channel/outbound tests and treat live Feishu validation as desirable but not mandatory.

options.title: Retire raw JSON auto-detection
options.body: Document that plain `message` card JSON is no longer supported and direct users to structured `presentation` or `channelData.feishu.card` sends.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a candidate branch or maintainer run shows the supplied card JSON rendering as an interactive card in a real Feishu chat.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the documented Feishu plugin contact and best available owner for Feishu-specific compatibility and live-proof expectations.
